content:
No, I can’t process audio input or output—I don’t have access to your microphone, speakers, or any real-time audio capabilities. I’m a text-based AI, so our conversation happens entirely through typed messages.

However, you can:
- Type your questions or thoughts here, and I’ll respond thoughtfully and in detail.  
- Use your device’s built-in text-to-speech (TTS) or speech-to-text (STT) tools if you’d like to *convert* speech to text (to send to me) or text to speech (to hear my replies). Many devices and browsers support this natively (e.g., Chrome’s “Dictation” or macOS’s Voice Control).

Let me know how I can best support you — whether it’s explaining a concept, helping with writing, solving a problem, or just chatting! 😊
